1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Drive a broad, gently curving short course around two barriers while holding two slow inspection sigils through generous windows.
1.natural_language: Clear two moving hover checks while driving the short obstacle course. Keep the vehicle on the broad road and hold each visible sigil until it locks.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Drive a longer three-barrier course while tracking three moving sigils with moderate orbits and overlapping attention demands.
2.natural_language: Clear three moving hover checks while steering around three barriers. Keep the vehicle moving and hold each visible sigil until it locks.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Coordinate four checks and four barriers on a curving course; each sigil moves faster and its window leaves less recovery time.
3.natural_language: Clear four moving hover checks while continuously steering through the four-barrier course. Plan speed so every check can lock before the finish.

4.label: hard
4.summary: The existing five-check, six-barrier inertial course: 11 to 13 contiguous dwell ticks on independently moving sigils, with a speed tradeoff before tick 330.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Coordinate six faster, smaller moving sigils while threading eight barriers on a narrower, tighter-curving course; late windows overlap and demand a deliberate speed plan.
5.natural_language: Clear all six fast moving hover checks while steering the narrow eight-barrier course. Regulate speed so the late overlapping locks complete before the deadline.

simplified.summary: Visible toggle buttons hold throttle, brake, and steering states, while LOCK ACTIVE SIGIL follows the visible current sigil.

full.summary: Held WASD or arrow keys drive the hovercar while direct canvas pointer movement sustains each sigil dwell.
